name: Ada Lio
profileSummary: Ada Lio is an American professional pool player, instructor, and health equity professional. She competes on the Women's Professional Billiard Association (WPBA) tour and serves in leadership roles both within the sport and in advocacy and strategy work focused on health care accessibility. In 2025 she was ranked the 26th best female player by the WPBA. Outside of sports, she is the executive director of the ZTTK SON-Shine Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to researching ZTTK syndrome, and a Director of Strategy at CVS Health.
